recipes.procedure: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface. Spread tomato sauce evenly over the base, sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese, and add fresh basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake for 10-15 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbling. Slice and serve hot.

Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large salad bowl. Prepare dressing by mixing olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, anchovy paste, and parmesan cheese. Toss lettuce with dressing until evenly coated. Add croutons and extra parmesan on top. Serve immediately.

Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. While pasta cooks, fry pancetta until crisp. Beat eggs with grated Parmesan cheese in a bowl. Drain pasta and quickly toss with pancetta and egg mixture off heat to avoid scrambling. Season with black pepper and extra cheese. Serve warm.

Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until golden. Add chopped vegetables (carrots, beans, peas) and cook for 5 minutes. Add soaked basmati rice, water, and biryani spices. Cover and simmer until rice is cooked and fluffy. Garnish with fried onions and fresh coriander. Serve with raita.

In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. In another bowl, whisk milk, eggs, and melted butter. Combine wet and dry ingredients gently; don’t overmix. Heat a non-stick pan, pour batter in small rounds, and cook until bubbles form. Flip and cook the other side. Serve with maple syrup and fresh fruit.

Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they break down. Add vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth, season with salt, pepper, and fresh basil. Serve hot with a drizzle of cream and toasted bread.

Marinate chicken strips with lime juice, chili powder, cumin, garlic, and salt for at least 30 minutes. Grill or pan-fry until cooked through. Warm tortillas, fill with chicken, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and shredded cheese. Top with salsa and sour cream. Serve immediately.

Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Grease ramekins with butter and dust with cocoa powder. Melt chocolate and butter together. Beat eggs, sugar, and vanilla until light and fluffy. Fold in chocolate mixture and flour gently. Pour into ramekins and bake for 12 minutes. Center will be gooey. Serve warm with ice cream.

Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. In a pan, cook ground beef with onions, garlic, rice, tomato sauce, and spices. Stuff mixture into peppers. Place in baking dish, cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve.
Blend frozen bananas with a splash of milk until smooth. Pour into a bowl and top with granola, sliced fruits, chia seeds, and a drizzle of honey. Serve chilled as a refreshing breakfast or snack.
